Callout.Name: Fire in an Alleyway
Callout.Message: Rubbish alight in an alley between buildings.
Callout.Advisory: No persons about, fence beginning to scorch.

Script.Line: It is not ours. It was going before we opened up.
It has come up through the boards and it is under the fence now.
There is a gas main along that wall. That is why we called you straight away.

Lines.Approach: It is in the alley between the buildings and the fence is going to go first.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
